edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: The neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs), also known as Batten disease, are a group of rare monogenic neurodegenerative diseases predominantly affecting children.

edges.subject: CLN1 disease
edges.quote: To date, 13 NCL subtypes (CLN1-8, CLN10-14) have been identified, based on the particular disease-causing defective gene.
